name: kurs-world
description: Real-time multi-source currency exchange rate aggregator and public developer API

scripts.dev: bun ./scripts/ensure-bun.ts && bun x concurrently -k -n "BE,FE" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "bun run dev:be" "bun run dev:fe"
scripts.test: bun test backend && bun test frontend
scripts.build: (cd backend && bun run build 2>/dev/null || true) && (cd frontend && bun run build)
scripts.check: (cd backend && (bun run check 2>/dev/null || tsc --noEmit)) && (cd frontend && bun run check)
